trigger.summary: geo-audit run 2026-08-11 found the firm's research library is unciteable and its entity is unresolvable.

_provenance.contact_history: absent from the canonical register, no contact column populated
_provenance.diagnostic_from: geo-audit orchestrator and its five subordinate agents, run 2026-08-11
_provenance.why_geo_was_appropriate: An advisory firm sells expertise that buyers research through AI answers. The reconnaissance found no robots.txt, no llms.txt, no sitemap.xml and no schema, so the hypothesis was testable rather than assumed.

diagnostic.score_method: citability 71 x 0.25 + brand 26 x 0.20 + eeat 51 x 0.20 + technical 57 x 0.15 + schema 0 x 0.10 + platform 34 x 0.10 = 45.1

findings.claim: A Wikipedia API search returns no article for the firm under any of its trading names, so the strongest entity-recognition signal AI models use is absent.
A separate live company trades as GBS Africa at gbsafrica.net and is also Nairobi-based, so AI systems have no disambiguation anchor for the London advisory firm.
/llms.txt returns HTTP 404, so the site publishes no machine-readable summary of the firm, its services or its report library.
Six fetched pages each returned HTTP 200 and each contained zero JSON-LD, microdata and RDFa markup, so structured data is absent site-wide rather than page-specific.
The Twitter and LinkedIn profiles are linked as plain anchor tags in the footer with no sameAs property, so no machine-readable cross-platform entity link exists.
/robots.txt returns HTTP 404 with an Apache error page, so there is no crawl directive file and no sitemap reference for any crawler.
Both /sitemap.xml and /sitemap_index.xml return HTTP 404, so no URL inventory or lastmod data is exposed to any crawler.
The Reports link in the primary navigation on every page points to /reports and returns HTTP 404, so the firm's most citable asset sits behind a broken nav path.
Every research item on the Insights page links straight to a PDF or PPT file under /assets/docs/report/ with no HTML landing page, so the firm's primary research exists in no citable web page.
No item in the Insights section shows an author name, and twelve of the thirteen items show no publication date on the listing page.
The About page lists nine team members and seven advisory board members with names, roles and photos, but publishes no biography, qualification or profile link for any of them.
The homepage Our Clients section ships unedited placeholder filler copy beginning 'Rooms oh fully taken by worse do'.
The footer Terms, Privacy and Cookies links are coded as href=# and open no page, so a UK-registered advisory firm publishes no privacy policy or terms.
Plain HTTP requests to the homepage return HTTP 200 directly with no redirect to HTTPS, so the site is served in full over an unencrypted connection.
Phase 1 reconnaissance reported that the homepage serves no title tag and no meta description.
Four subordinate agents reading the raw HTML found a title tag reading 'GBS Africa - Your trusted partner on Africa Matters!' and a meta description tag that is present but empty.
